hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.md) npx markdownlint-cli2 "$f" || true;; esac; }
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.json) python3 -m json.tool "$f" > /dev/null 2>&1 || echo "Invalid JSON: $f";; esac; }
